caption:
Before the next sale: set a cap first. 💵
1. Write a number you can pay in cash.
2. Put it in your notes app before you open any store.
3. Wait 24 hours on anything not on your list.
In one survey, 22% of shoppers expected to still be paying for this year's purchases after January.
What's your cap this year?
